title: IAMMAI First-Pass Currentness Record
description: First-pass schema for one bounded currentness claim only. This object is small, explicit, authority-locating rather than authority-generating, and recorded-first rather than computed-first. It records what presently governs for one scope, in what posture, on what basis, and against which visible non-current neighbors, without becoming a dashboard, storage model, or final current-state ontology.

currentness_record_id.description: Bounded identifier for this one currentness record object. It makes the currentness claim referable without implying a final global identity system or sovereign current-state machinery.

recorded_at.description: Recorded-at value for when this bounded currentness claim was explicitly housed as an object. This remains a conservative non-empty string rather than a frozen final timestamp model.

scope_ref.description: Bounded reference for the one scope whose currentness is being claimed. This keeps the object local rather than letting it drift into whole-body totality.

current_ref.description: Bounded surface that presently governs for the named scope. This locates the current governing surface without pretending to generate that authority.

current_posture.description: Bounded posture in which current_ref presently stands for the named scope. The field is required, but the posture vocabulary remains intentionally open and revisable in first-pass form.

basis_refs.description: Explicit bounded references that justify why current_ref is being recorded as current for this scope. This is central to currentness and is not optional convenience.

non_current_refs.description: Explicit bounded nearby references that remain visible for the same scope but should not be mistaken as presently governing there. This is central to currentness and is not optional convenience.
